newsitem.title: USA: Endorex sets 1-for-15 reverse stock split.
newsitem.headline: Endorex sets 1-for-15 reverse stock split.

text.p: Endorex Corp said Tuesday it effected a one-for-15 reverse stock split of its common stock, effective at the opening of trading on Wednesday, June 11.
After the split, Endorex will have about 1,087,925 shares of common stock outstanding. The company said the stock will trade under the symbol ENDR.

"The reverse stock split is the next step in our strategy of increasing Endorex's visibility with the financial community and investing public," Michael Rosen, Endorex president and chief executive, said.
"Following the reverse stock split and the successful completion of other financing efforts, it is our goal to apply for listing on the NASDAQ SmallCap Market," he said.
